section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 2, an experimental study designed to test causal links between introjected regulation, appearance vs. health frames for exercise, guilt induction, and body image. The study manipulates appearance vs. health frames and guilt vs. no guilt conditions using a magazine article style manipulation, with hypotheses that guilt conditions will increase post-test guilt and body anxiety, and that guilt (not appearance frame) will mediate the effect on body anxiety. The section also discusses potential treatment-mediation interaction effects based on individual variation in susceptibility to the guilt manipulation.
